faq: Can an AI agent answer parents on WhatsApp for a swim school?

Yes. 41 Closer runs on your own WhatsApp number and answers each parent the moment the message lands, at 10pm or between your lessons. It places the child in a programme by age, collects what you need to match a coach and offers the trial lesson. You get the finished trial request and the whole chat. It is built and run by 41 Labs, so you do not set anything up yourself.
What does it do when a parent asks for a female coach on Saturday morning?

It notes the preference and the days, asks for the one detail still missing and then offers the trial. It never confirms a coach or a slot it cannot see. The request reaches you with the age, the condo, the days, the coach preference and private or group. You text your coaches once and confirm the slot yourself.
Will it book the trial lesson for me?

On Starter it takes the trial request and hands it to you on WhatsApp, with a recap to the parent that says you will confirm the coach and the slot. On Pro, with your booking calendar or coach sheet connected, it writes the booking back and can take the trial payment in the chat. Connecting a system we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400. If the parent goes quiet after the trial offer, it checks in after three hours and again the next day.

Starter is S$690 a month. Pro is S$1,490 a month. The build is included and there is no setup fee. You pay one month to start, charged from go-live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract. What if a parent asks whether the trial is free this month?

If your price list says what the trial costs, it quotes that. If you have not told us, it says your admin confirms the fee and any current promotion, then carries on with the next question. It never invents a price or a promo. Anything it does not know goes to you with the parent's details, so nobody is left hanging.
Does it work for a tennis coach or a football academy?

The shape is the same. A parent gives the child's age, the location, the days, a coach preference and private or group, and you match a coach. We build it on your own sessions and price list. We have built this for a swim school, not yet for tennis or football, so you would be the first in your sport and we would tell you that on the call.

It replies in English and in the mixed English Singapore parents type. In the swim school demo it also replied in Chinese when a daughter wrote in Chinese about lessons for her mother. Ask us before you count on any other language.
How fast can it go live?

It is live within 48 hours of us getting your programme list and price list. Before you pay, we build the agent and you message it yourself. Then one free hour, where we walk you through the platform and connect payments and your WhatsApp number. Billing starts the day it goes live.
